notes: U1 mask only covered the skull; now skull-and-crossbones (SAM3, verified) and ref names the full print. U2 drawstring bag -> drawstring bag was colour/material only; now a woven straw tote, ref tightened (a second black bag hangs next to it). U3 ref disambiguated between the two wire baskets. U4 add without site kept.

spec.ref: the skull-and-crossbones graphic on the rightmost striped shirt

units.ref_zh: 最右侧条纹上衣上的骷髅交叉骨图案
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除最右侧条纹上衣上的骷髅交叉骨图案。
units.reason: The print is a skull with crossbones beneath (source y 506-832); mask now covers both so no orphaned crossbones remain.

spec.ref: the large black drawstring bag hanging below the striped shirts

units.ref_zh: 条纹上衣下方悬挂的大黑色抽绳袋
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将条纹上衣下方悬挂的大黑色抽绳袋替换为一个草编托特包。

units.reason: The bag already is a drawstring bag, so 'brown canvas drawstring bag' was a colour/material change; a straw tote is structural. A smaller black bag hangs on a hook just right of it, so 'large' is added.
